imageModels.name: Seedream 5.0 lite
imageModels.example:
curl https://api-direct.sumone.hk/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {your-api-key} \
  -d '{
    "model": "doubao-seedream-5-0-260128",
    "prompt": "将图1的服装换为图2的服装",
    "image": ["https://ark-project.tos-cn-beijing.volces.com/doc_image/seedream4_imagesToimage_1.png", "https://ark-project.tos-cn-beijing.volces.com/doc_image/seedream4_5_imagesToimage_2.png"],
    "sequential_image_generation": "disabled",
    "size": "2K",
    "output_format":"png",
    "watermark": false
}'

imageModels.name: gpt-image-2
imageModels.example:
curl https://api-direct.sumone.hk/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {your-api-key} \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-image-2",
    "prompt": "将这张参考图中的现代客厅风格改为「赛博朋克」霓虹风格，保留基本的家具布局，但增加全息投影和蓝紫色灯光。",
    "image_url": "https://your-domain.com/base-image.jpg",
    "strength": 0.75,
    "n": 1,
    "size": "1024x1024",
    "quality": "high",
    "response_format": "url"
  }'
